title: Fast detection of melamine using silver nanoparticles capped with L-cysteine functionalized carbon dots

Koffi Koffi Kra Sylvestre, Dan Li, Essy Kouadio Fodjo, Aka Alla Martin, Pomi Bi Boussou Narcisse, Irié Bi Irié Williams
Melamine is an additive used fraudulently to enrich foods with nitrogen, particularly in the dairy industry. The toxicity of melamine-enriched pet and child foods has been a source of concern these last years.
